nodes.summary: For every complex number $s$, the divisor-power sum $\sigma_s(n) = \sum_{d \mid n} d^s$ with complex exponent $s$ satisfies $\sigma_s(1) = 1$.
nodes.title: The complex-exponent divisor sum at one

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ and complex number $s$, the divisor-power sum $\sigma_s$ with complex exponent $s$ satisfies $\sigma_s(n) = \sum_{d \mid n} d^s$, the sum running over the positive divisors $d$ of $n$; for $n = 0$ the sum is empty, so $\sigma_s(0) = 0$.
nodes.title: Divisor-sum formula for the complex-exponent divisor sum

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $k$ and $n$, the value at $n$ of the complex-exponent divisor sum $\sum_{d \mid n} d^s$ with $s = k$ equals the natural number $\sigma_k(n) = \sum_{d \mid n} d^k$, viewed as a complex number.
nodes.title: Natural exponents give the classical divisor function

nodes.summary: Let $\sigma_s(n) = \sum_{d \mid n} d^s$ be the divisor-power sum with complex exponent $s$. For every natural number $n$, $\sigma_0(n)$ equals the number of positive divisors of $n$, with the convention that $0$ has no divisors, so that $\sigma_0(0) = 0$.
nodes.title: The complex-exponent divisor sum at exponent zero counts divisors

nodes.summary: For a complex number $s$, $\sigma_s$ is the complex-valued arithmetic function with $\sigma_s(n) = \sum_{d \mid n} d^s$ for every natural number $n \ge 1$, where $d^s$ is the complex power, and $\sigma_s(0) = 0$.
nodes.title: Divisor-power sum with complex exponent

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
